B = np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62_ROWS.strip().split("\n")])
IDX = {c:i for i,c in enumerate(B62_ORDER)}
def enc(s): return np.array([IDX.get(c, IDX['X']) for c in s])

def nw_identity(s1, s2, gap=11):
    a, b = enc(s1), enc(s2); n, m = len(a), len(b)
    M = np.full((n+1, m+1), -10**6, dtype=np.int64); P = np.zeros((n+1, m+1), dtype=np.int8)
    M[0,:] = -gap*np.arange(m+1); P[0,1:]=2
    jr = np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        sub = B[a[i-1], b]
        diag = M[i-1,:-1] + sub; up = M[i-1,1:] - gap
        t = np.empty(m+1, dtype=np.int64); t[0] = -gap*i; t[1:] = np.maximum(diag, up)
        ptr = np.zeros(m+1, dtype=np.int8); ptr[1:] = np.where(diag >= up, 0, 1); ptr[0]=1
        row = np.maximum.accumulate(t + gap*jr) - gap*jr
        P[i] = np.where(row > t, 2, ptr); M[i] = row
    i, j, ident, alen, aligned_cols = n, m, 0, 0, 0
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i>0 and j>0 and P[i,j]==0:
            alen+=1; aligned_cols+=1; ident += (s1[i-1]==s2[j-1]); i-=1; j-=1
        elif i>0 and (j==0 or P[i,j]==1): alen+=1; i-=1
        else: alen+=1; j-=1
    return 100.0*ident/max(aligned_cols,1), alen, aligned_cols

ACCS = [

 ("HP_1507 H.pylori CASDH (struct)","O26037"),
 ("WS0167 W.succinogenes (4INA)","Q7MSS8"),
 ("VC_1624 CANSDH V.cholerae","Q9KRL3"),
 ("CANSDH V.alginolyticus","P0DPE4"),
 ("B.fragilis fam. member (8DEB)","I9VY56"),
 ("HSS Blastochloris (2.5.1.44)","O32323"),
 ("LYS9 yeast SDH (1.5.1.10)","P38999"),
 ("LYS1 yeast SDH (1.5.1.7)","P38998"),
 ("PH1688 Pyrococcus SDH (3ABI)","O59312"),
]
seqs={}
for lab,acc in ACCS:
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta", timeout=30)
    seqs[lab] = "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:])

labs=[l for l,_ in ACCS]
n=len(labs); Mid=np.zeros((n,n))
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i,n):
        if i==j: Mid[i,j]=100.0; continue
        pid,_,_ = nw_identity(seqs[labs[i]], seqs[labs[j]])
        Mid[i,j]=Mid[j,i]=pid
df = pd.DataFrame(Mid, index=labs, columns=labs).round(1)
pd.set_option("display.width",300)
print("Pairwise global (Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap=11) %identity over aligned columns\n")
print(df.to_string())
print("\nRow for the query Cj0172c, sorted:")
print(df["Cj0172c C.jejuni 11168 (query)"].drop("Cj0172c C.jejuni 11168 (query)").sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5,8.2))
sns.heatmap(df, annot=True, fmt=".0f", cmap="viridis", vmin=0, vmax=60, ax=ax,
            cbar_kws={"label":"% identity (global alignment)"})
ax.set_title("Cj0172c sits in the carboxypolyamine dehydrogenase clade,\nnot with true saccharopine dehydrogenases", fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha="right"); plt.yticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
